scripts.docker-clean: docker images | grep particles | awk '{print $3}' | xargs docker rmi
scripts.docker-update: docker rm -f particles && npm run docker-clean && npm run docker-build && npm run docker-run
scripts.podman-clean: podman images | grep particles | awk '{print $3}' | xargs -r podman rmi
scripts.podman-update: sudo podman rm -f particles && npm run podman-build && npm run podman-run
